research_notes: Follow up substantive full-time consulting periods and breaks, Farmshed tenure/secondment, PJP final date, and contract-level dates for Rabobank and university teaching. Distinguish agribusiness investment/board roles from any paid advisory work.

2026-09-29 avenues: APH occupation text, contemporaneous PJP/ANZ report, McKinsey ownership history, ASX July 2001 indexed filing, government-hosted speaker biography, public conference profile, ABC and business reporting, targeted full-time/early-career/Rabobank/EAI searches. ASX current page lacked announcement body; retained transparent indexed evidence. No paid registries or access restrictions bypassed.

Follow-up corporate leads, not confirmed employment spells: Centaurus Partners, Agricultural Managers Limited, Agriculture Managers Australia, Australian Agricultural Securitisation, Resolution Manager and JRAT. Search reporting describes directorships/consulting, but legal entities, contracts and paid activity require primary filings. Victorian gas taskforce is an advisory appointment lead, not automatically public-service employment.

No assumption that founding or owning a farm means full-time farming. Resolve 1998/1999 Growth Farms discrepancy and EAI resignation separately from EAA's 2009 end. Dates and senior titles alone do not establish hours. All consulting, directorship and educational overlaps remain non-additive. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record unresolved.
